result.topic_en: A note asking that a footnote above result (1.61) mention an apparent error in Comptes Rendus about the error of p(61), correcting an inversion made in yesterday's letter, and proposing a small table of maximum and minimum values of |c_s(n)| for the partition paper.
result.transcription:
Add Ms a 94 17(11) (104)
Please mention in a foot note
above the result (1.61) that
there was a mistake in Comptes
Rendus concerning the error of
p(61) over p(61). I think it was
given there as $-44.641$ instead
of the correct value $-34.641$.
Please ascertain if there was
really a mistake: the figures
might not have been mentioned
in Comptes Rendus.
In yesterday's letter instead of
writing $\frac{\pi^2}{\sin\pi\alpha\sin\pi\beta}$, $\frac{\pi^3}{\sin\pi\alpha\sin\pi\beta\sin\pi\gamma}$ &c [?]
I inverted them in haste.
Is it not better to construct
a small table showing the maxi-
-mum value $M_s(n)$ and mini-
-mum $m_s(n)$ of $|c_s(n)|$ in the
partition paper like this

$s$ | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | ...... | 18
$M_s(n)$ | 1 | 1 | $2\cos\frac{\pi}{18}$ [?] | $2\cos\frac{\pi}{8}$ [?] | ...... | .
$m_s(n)$ | 1 | 1 | $2\sin\frac{\pi}{9}$ [?] | $2\sin\frac{\pi}{8}$ [?] | ...... |
